description: This file defines a PHP class 'Statistics' within the Opencart framework. The class handles various event-driven methods related to statistics updates, such as adding review counts, return counts, and order status transitions. It interacts with models like 'report/statistics' and 'checkout/order' to modify statistical data based on specific triggers.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Controller class for handling statistics-related events such as reviews, returns, and order status updates within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: addReview
methods.description: Increments the 'review' statistic count when a review is added.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Increments the 'returns' statistic count when a return is added.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Updates statistical values based on order status changes, such as sale totals and processing/complete statuses.
